Game Overview

Jet Micky is a strategy game built around guide Jet Micky, a cheese-loving rodent, through danger-laden levels in this thrilling adventure. Maneuver with precision and timing to avoid cunning traps while collecting savory cheese. It's a test of skill and patience where strategic thinking and impeccable movement are your keys to satisfying Micky's hunger safely!
